leftovers: About 140 g reduced-fat Mexican cheese (keeps 3 weeks once opened)

breakfast.blurb: Cocoa oats with peanut butter powder and banana.
steps: Whisk whey, cocoa and PB2 into the almond milk until smooth.
Stir in yogurt, oats and salt.
Divide between 4 jars. Slice the bananas and push the slices into the top of each jar so they're covered (stops browning).
Lid and refrigerate.
breakfast.title: Chocolate peanut butter banana overnight oats

dessert.blurb: Fudgy oat-flour brownies topped with a thick chocolate peanut butter yogurt frosting.

ingredients.amount: 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp vanilla, ¼ tsp salt

dessert.portionNote: Cut into 4 large squares, one per day
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8 pan with parchment.
Blend the oats to a fine flour. Whisk with 80 g of the whey, 40 g cocoa, baking powder and salt.
In another bowl mash the bananas, then whisk in eggs, 150 g yogurt, maple syrup and vanilla.
Fold wet into dry until just combined, then fold in the chocolate chips. Spread in the pan.
Bake 20–24 min until the middle is just set. Cool completely in the pan.
Frosting: whisk 400 g yogurt with the remaining 30 g whey, 10 g cocoa and the PB2 until thick and smooth.
Cut the brownie into 4 squares, put each in a container and spread a quarter of the frosting on top.
dessert.storage: Fridge, up to 5 days. Best eaten cold.
dessert.title: Banana protein brownies with chocolate PB frosting

main.blurb: Lean turkey ragù with carrots, blended cottage cheese and Parmesan over protein penne.

ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, ½ tsp chili, 2 tsp salt
ingredients.item: Italian seasoning, chili flakes, salt, pepper

main.portionNote: 12 containers: 3 a day for Sat, Sun, Mon and Tue. Freeze Tuesday's 3.
steps: Heat oil in your largest pot over medium-high. Add onion, carrot and a pinch of salt; cook 6–8 min until soft.
Add garlic for 1 min, then the turkey. Break it up and cook until no longer pink, 8–10 min.
Add both jars of marinara, Italian seasoning and chili. Rinse each jar with a splash of water into the pot. Simmer 15 min.
Meanwhile boil the pasta 1 minute less than the packet says. Drain.
Blend the cottage cheese until smooth. Take the sauce off the heat and stir in the cottage cheese and Parmesan. Season.
Toss pasta with the sauce. Let cool 20 min, then divide between 12 containers (weigh the pot and split by weight).
Label 9 containers for Sat–Mon (fridge) and 3 for Tuesday (freezer).
main.storage: Fridge 9 portions for Sat–Mon. Freeze Tuesday's 3 and move them to the fridge Monday night. Reheat 2–3 min with a splash of water.
main.title: Creamy turkey bolognese with protein pasta

timeline: Heat oven to 350°F. Make and bake the brownies; let them cool while you cook.
Start the bolognese. Put the pasta water on.
While the sauce simmers, make the overnight oats.
Finish the bolognese, cool, portion 12 containers. 3 go in the freezer.
Make the frosting, cut and frost the brownies.

breakfast.blurb: Creamy vanilla oats with chia and wild blueberries.
steps: In a large bowl whisk the whey into the almond milk until there are no lumps.
Stir in the Greek yogurt, oats, chia, cinnamon and salt until smooth.
Divide evenly between 3 jars (weigh the bowl and split by weight if you can).
Top each jar with 60 g frozen blueberries straight from the freezer. Lid and refrigerate.
breakfast.storage: Fridge, up to 4 days. Eat cold straight from the jar.
breakfast.title: Blueberry vanilla overnight oats

dessert.blurb: No-bake cottage cheese cheesecake on a graham crunch base.
steps: Blend cottage cheese in a blender or food processor until completely smooth (1–2 min).
Add yogurt, whey, 1 tbsp honey, lemon zest, half the lemon juice, vanilla and salt. Blend until thick and smooth. Taste; add more lemon if wanted.
Divide graham crumbs between 3 pots (30 g each), press down lightly.
Spoon the filling over the crumbs.
Warm the blueberries in a small pan with the remaining honey and lemon juice for 3–4 min until jammy. Cool, then spoon on top.
Chill at least 2 hours before eating.
dessert.title: Lemon blueberry cheesecake pots

main.blurb: Smoky chicken, rice, black beans, peppers, salsa and a yogurt crema.

ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp chipotle, 2 tsp each cumin + paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt
ingredients.item: Chipotle chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, salt

main.portionNote: 9 containers: 3 a day for Wed, Thu and Fri
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cook the rice per the packet (rice cooker is fine).
Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces. Toss with 2 tsp oil, the spices, minced garlic and the juice of 1 lime. Spread on 2 lined sheet pans.
Toss peppers and onion with remaining oil and a pinch of salt; add to the pans. Roast 18–22 min until chicken reaches 165°F.
Warm the drained beans in a small pan with a pinch of salt.
Crema: stir the 270 g Greek yogurt with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt and chipotle. Spoon into 9 small lidded pots (30 g each).
Let everything cool 20 min. Portion into 9 containers: rice, beans, chicken + veg evenly, then 50 g salsa and 10 g cheese each.
Label containers with today's date and the day to eat them.
main.storage: Fridge. Eat by Friday. Reheat 2–3 min, then add the cold crema pot.
main.title: Chipotle chicken burrito bowls

timeline: Start the rice. Heat oven to 425°F.
Make the cheesecake pots first (they need 2 hours to chill).
Make the overnight oats and put them in the fridge.
Prep and roast the chicken and veg. While it roasts, warm the beans and make the crema.
Cool 20 minutes, then portion the bowls, label and refrigerate.
